summary.text: Robyn Essex is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 78 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is a real estate agent and a former district representative for U.S. Senator Jerry Moran.

paragraphs.text: Robyn Essex graduated from Apple Valley High School and earned a B.A. in business administration and psychology from MidAmerica Nazarene University in 1990.
Her career experience includes working as a real estate agent, as a district representative for U.S. Senator Jerry Moran and as a kindergarten aide with the Olathe School District.
Essex has served as president of the Sunflower Club, as a Kansas Republican Party precinct committeewoman and on the Olathe, Kansas, city council.
Essex assumed office in the Kansas House on January 9, 2023, succeeding Ron Ryckman.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Local Government, Taxation, Transportation and Water committees and served as vice chair of the House Transportation Committee.
Tim Lundberg is the Democratic candidate for the seat in the November 2026 general election.
